title: Silent Night at Marlowe's
premise: Every Christmas Eve, after the doors close, the staff of Marlowe's department store hold their party in the Food Hall, under the big tree.
Tonight the owner, Gideon Marlowe, announced he has sold the store. Then, at 9:30, came the staff Secret Santa. Gideon opened his gift first: a box of truffles. He ate one and collapsed.
Gideon was badly allergic to nuts. His adrenaline pen should have been in his jacket. It wasn't. He died at 9:45.
The snow has closed every road. DI Nora Snow, a guest at the party, has locked the doors. Nobody leaves until she knows who did this.
rules: Talk, question, accuse, bargain and lie as much as you like.
Everything on your sheet can be shared or hidden. Your call.
The one thing you can never reveal is your secret goal.
Props change hands only when the holder hands them over. No snatching.
At the end everyone votes in secret for the killer. Catch them and the group wins. Meet your secret goal and you win a bonus prize too.

victim.name: Gideon Marlowe
victim.text: The victim. Owner of Marlowe's, 68, allergic to nuts. He sold the store tonight.

run_of_show: As DI Snow, read the premise and lay out the scene round Gideon's chair (10 min)
Start Round 2 from your dashboard, open the staff lockers, search and discuss (25 min)
Final statements, open voting, reveal, then secret goals and the chocolates (15 min)
